verdict.summary: The workflow change correctly gives the coverage-engine run matrix and merge job the same rust-cache namespace via an identical shared-key, while preserving the existing save-on-main policy. The regression tests are non-vacuous: they locate both top-level jobs, require at least one rust-cache step in each, assert a shared-key is present and equal across jobs, and reject reintroduction of the job-scoped key input. The targeted test class passes at the PR head. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue was found in the diff.
